headline: Aeterna Lucis December 3
title: Aeterna Lucis Release Date December 3 | Metroidvania Finally Lands | Gaming News
video_script: Aeterna Lucis, the metroidvania from Aeternum Game Studios, now has a release date: December third, twenty twenty six. It was delayed from twenty twenty five, and it is coming to PlayStation five, Xbox Series, PlayStation four, Xbox One, Switch and PC on Steam. A Switch two version has not been announced. Will you play it on day one? Comment below!
description: Aeterna Lucis launches December 3, 2026 on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series, Xbox One, Switch and PC. The date was announced September 10, 2026. Sources: Gematsu, Final Weapon.
joke: I hope the date does not get delayed again, my patience bar is already empty.
